status: bounded ALIGNED change; selected graph, not whole-file qualification
problem: DXF output drops nonzero group 52 extension-line rotation from ALIGNED DIMENSION records.

authority.dwg: ODA v5.4.1 section 20.4.25 lists extension-line rotation for ALIGNED.

change: Emit an existing nonzero ALIGNED oblique field as group 52 inside AcDbAlignedDimension. LINEAR emission and other subtypes are unchanged. Refuse a nonfinite newly emitted ALIGNED value before writing, latch failure, preserve destination and permit corrected same-writer retry. R12 remains unsupported as before.
physical_source: An authored seven-subtype DXF contains LINEAR 52=20 degrees and ALIGNED 52=25 degrees. ODA AC1024 DWG and AC1027 DXF return those values; LibreDWG independently observes the corresponding wire radian values. ODA invocation provenance is a manually observed join. The author helper recreates the geometry and field values but does not promise byte-identical metadata.
output_evidence: The probe imports the ODA-returned DXF and selects seven dimensions, required picture blocks and source tables into an authored graph. It resets source owners and adds a named-block copy and GROUP. Independent raw-tag inspection confirms selected ASCII/Binary LINEAR and ALIGNED 52 values 20/25 in AcDbAlignedDimension; GROUP remap and named block are checked. ODA converts those selected files to AC1024 DWG and back to AC1027 DXF, retaining 20/25. This does not qualify full source-file output or other native applications.
compatibility_limit: ezdxf 1.4.5 directly reports zero for both selected group-52 values while they reside in AcDbAlignedDimension; its independent raw-tag reader confirms both stored values and ODA roundtrip restores them. A separately matched group-placement control confirms ezdxf observes values in AcDbDimension, while ODA accepts both locations. The implementation preserves Autodesk-documented AcDbAlignedDimension placement and does not change existing LINEAR bytes; no claim of direct ezdxf semantic compatibility is made.
tests: Fixture-free structural and typed-reader controls cover AC1015/1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 in ASCII/Binary. LINEAR and ALIGNED nonzero values appear in AcDbAlignedDimension; five other standard subtypes and zero defaults emit no group 52. R12 refusal and nonfinite ALIGNED write with ignored callback failure each preserve a destination sentinel; same-writer corrected retry succeeds.
integrated_validation: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^libdxfrw_dxf_dimension_oblique$' --output-on-failure: 1/1 passed; selected ASCII producer/ODA audit passed.
